content: Farmer trust in AI ag recommendations is low: ~2026 survey found only 24% fully/somewhat trust AI recommendations for operational decisions; 45% uncomfortable letting AI influence real decisions; top concern (72%) is accuracy, since a recommendation valid on one field can fail on another due to local conditions. Key failure modes: LLM hallucination of agronomic numbers without domain validation, over-reliance causing farmers to stop catching erroneous AI decisions, and lack of explainability (XAI) undermining trust when rationale can't be verified.
